title: Stieltjes moment classification of Apéry polynomials
description: Paper, LaTeX source and verification code. The new claimed result is the non-Stieltjes range 0<x<1, completing the nonnegative-real-parameter classification. Positivity for every x>=1 was previously proved by Knowledge Sense (October 2026), with the x=1 case due to Edgar; our proof of that range is alternative. See the README and PRIOR_WORK.md for attribution. Paper and data: CC BY 4.0; code: MIT.
